regulatory_history.title: Egan v. Cuebiq, Inc. (D. Mass. No. 1:23-cv-11650)
regulatory_history.body: US District Court for the District of Massachusetts
regulatory_history.notes: Against Cuebiq, Inc., before Cuebiq Group, LLC took over its business. Alleged that Cuebiq sold app users' precise location data without their consent (not proven in court). The plaintiff dropped the case three weeks after filing it.

sources.title: Egan v. Cuebiq, Inc. (D. Mass. No. 1:23-cv-11650), complaint
sources.quote: first acquiring and tracking consumers’ precise geolocation data and other data using spyware, and then profiting from that data by selling it

sources.title: Egan v. Cuebiq, Inc. (D. Mass. No. 1:23-cv-11650), notice of voluntary dismissal
sources.quote: hereby dismisses without prejudice all claims against Defendant Cuebiq, Inc.
